# Περιγραφικά χαρακτηριστικά ασθενών

```{r}
db_path <- fs::path("data.duckdb")

if (!fs::file_exists(path = db_path)) {
  rlang::abort(
    message = stringr::str_c(
      "Δεν βρέθηκε το αρχείο data.duckdb στον",
      "ριζικό κατάλογο του έργου.",
      sep = " "
    )
  )
}

connection <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = duckdb::duckdb(),
  dbdir = db_path,
  read_only = TRUE
)

icu_admissions <- tryCatch(
  expr = DBI::dbGetQuery(
    conn = connection,
    statement = stringr::str_c(
      "SELECT age_years, sex, apache_ii_score,",
      "mechanical_ventilation_days, icu_stay_days,",
      "icu_outcome, hospital_outcome",
      "FROM icu_admissions",
      "ORDER BY patient_id",
      sep = " "
    )
  ),
  finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(
    conn = connection,
    shutdown = TRUE
  )
)
```

## Πίνακας 1

```{r}
parse_numeric <- function(values) {
  normalized_values <- values |>
    stringr::str_squish() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      pattern = ",",
      replacement = "."
    ) |>
    dplyr::na_if(y = "")

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(x = normalized_values)
  )
}

format_number <- function(value, digits = 1L) {
  formatC(
    x = value,
    format = "f",
    digits = digits,
    decimal.mark = ","
  )
}

format_n_percent <- function(count, denominator, digits = 1L) {
  percentage <- format_number(
    value = 100 * count / denominator,
    digits = digits
  )

  stringr::str_c(
    count,
    " (",
    percentage,
    "%)"
  )
}

translate_categories <- function(values) {
  trimmed_values <- stringr::str_squish(string = values)
  normalized_values <- stringr::str_to_lower(string = trimmed_values)

  dplyr::case_when(
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "male",
      "m",
      "άνδρας",
      "ανδρας",
      "άρρεν",
      "αρρεν"
    ) ~ "Άνδρας",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "female",
      "f",
      "γυναίκα",
      "γυναικα",
      "θήλυ",
      "θηλυ"
    ) ~ "Γυναίκα",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "alive",
      "survived",
      "survivor",
      "επιβίωση",
      "επιβιωση",
      "επιβίωσε",
      "επιβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Επιβίωση",
    normalized_values %in% c(
      "dead",
      "deceased",
      "death",
      "θάνατος",
      "θανατος",
      "απεβίωσε",
      "απεβιωσε"
    ) ~ "Θάνατος",
    TRUE ~ trimmed_values
  )
}

summarise_continuous <- function(label, values) {
  numeric_values <- parse_numeric(values = values)
  available_values <- numeric_values[!is.na(numeric_values)]
  missing_count <- sum(x = is.na(numeric_values))

  if (length(x = available_values) == 0L) {
    summary_text <- "Μη διαθέσιμα"
  } else {
    quartiles <- stats::quantile(
      x = available_values,
      probs = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )
    summary_text <- stringr::str_c(
      format_number(value = quartiles[[2L]]),
      " [",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[1L]]),
      ", ",
      format_number(value = quartiles[[3L]]),
      "]"
    )
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable = label,
    summary = stringr::str_c(
      summary_text,
      "; ελλείποντα: ",
      missing_count
    )
  )
}

summarise_categorical <- function(label, values, denominator) {
  translated_values <- translate_categories(values = values)
  translated_values <- dplyr::if_else(
    condition = is.na(translated_values) | translated_values == "",
    true = "Μη διαθέσιμο",
    false = translated_values
  )

  counts <- tibble::tibble(category = translated_values) |>
    dplyr::count(
      category,
      name = "count",
      sort = FALSE
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      display = purrr::map_chr(
        .x = .data$count,
        .f = function(count) {
          format_n_percent(
            count = count,
            denominator = denominator
          )
        }
      )
    )

  tibble::tibble(
    variable = label,
    summary = stringr::str_c(
      counts$category,
      ": ",
      counts$display,
      sep = "",
      collapse = "<br>"
    )
  )
}

n_patients <- nrow(x = icu_admissions)

table_1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ηλικία (έτη)",
    values = icu_admissions$age_years
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Φύλο",
    values = icu_admissions$sex,
    denominator = n_patients
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Βαθμολογία APACHE II",
    values = icu_admissions$apache_ii_score
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ημέρες μηχανικού αερισμού",
    values = icu_admissions$mechanical_ventilation_days
  ),
  summarise_continuous(
    label = "Ημέρες παραμονής στη ΜΕΘ",
    values = icu_admissions$icu_stay_days
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Έκβαση στη ΜΕΘ",
    values = icu_admissions$icu_outcome,
    denominator = n_patients
  ),
  summarise_categorical(
    label = "Ενδονοσοκομειακή έκβαση",
    values = icu_admissions$hospital_outcome,
    denominator = n_patients
  )
)
```

knitr::kable(
  x = table_1,
  format = "pipe",
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Χαρακτηριστικό", "Περιγραφικά στοιχεία"),
  caption = "Πίνακας 1. Περιγραφικά χαρακτηριστικά των ασθενών."
)
